answer: Submissions that land within 45 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. The ocean detector writes to lotus, and jetty shows every merge. A farm scripting its whole army of identities fires them together, which means the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 295 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 35 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
